title: chrysobalanus icaco var. pellocarpus
intro: Chrysobalanus icaco var. pellocarpus, commonly known as the Jabillo or Ice Cream Bean tree, is a tropical plant species native to Central and South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues, due to its reported health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Chrysobalanus icaco var. pellocarpus are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
